rules: Use a new unique path-safe ID and real timestamps when creating.
Keep all unedited fields, including unknown metadata, extensions, and studio bags.
Templates are starting shapes, never live records or replacements for existing settings.
PUT replaces an entity; PATCH merges top-level fields. Deeply merge nested objects yourself.
Read back the saved file and verify bindings and prompt order.

character.notes: Flat card fields plus studio. Character ID comes from its directory. Keep extensions and unknown fields.

persona.notes: Default persona is settings.json personaId. Pin a persona on a chat to select it there.

preset.notes: prompts and prompt_order control runtime text/order; studio preserves section controls and other editor fields. Keep both copies consistent.

lorebook.notes: Entry status chooses normal, constant, or vectorized. Preserve extensions.

regex.notes: Scope, placements, markdownOnly, and promptOnly choose when and where it runs.

group.notes: memberIds refer to existing character IDs.

settings.notes: Patch the existing ui object. Do not replace a user configuration with the template.

library.fields: src/lib/types.ts: QuickReplySet, ThemePreset, Background, Tag, Folder, ConnectionProfile
library.notes: Collections share one file. Preserve every other collection when editing one.

databank.notes: Creation/content replacement uses the focused editor or upload route for chunking original text. Preserve opaque metadata and measure actual content size.

chat.notes: Keep every JSONL message field and inactive swipe. Text edits update the active swipe; structural actions and generation use app routes.
